title: Boiled Eggs
description: I like boiled eggs. Do you?
body:
This mod adds boiled eggs.
Craft a boiler with 7 cobblestone in a cauldron shape.
Make sure to have the eggs in your inventory before boiling because if you put water in the boiler and leave the GUI, it can get buggy.
Put a water bucket in the water slot and any amount of eggs in the egg slot. Do it in this order or it won't work. After 200 ticks, the eggs will turn into boiled eggs!
Happy eating!
